Delhi and Agra 2 day private tour by car

Delhi · Agra · Delhi · 2 days

2 days Taj Mahal tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

One day for Delhi, one for Agra, with a sunset at Mehtab Bagh in between and the Taj Mahal at sunrise the next morning.

At a glance

Duration
2 days, 1 night
Destinations
Delhi and Agra
Departure city
Delhi NCR
Transport
Private AC car
Tour type
Private
Language
English, other languages on request
Pickup
Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR
Return
Day 2, evening

What makes this one worth it

  • A full day across Delhi's landmarks with a private guide
  • Sunset over the Taj Mahal from Mehtab Bagh
  • Sunrise at the Taj Mahal on day two, before the crowds
  • Agra Fort with time to actually walk it
  • One night in Agra, so neither city gets rushed

Your day by day

  1. Day 1 · 8:00 AM

    Delhi sightseeing with your guide

    Pickup in Delhi, then India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, Parliament House and the city's other landmarks with your guide.

  2. Day 1 · 12:30 PM

    The drive to Agra

    Drive to Agra on the Yamuna Expressway, arriving mid-afternoon to check in.

  3. Day 1 · 5:00 PM

    Sunset on the Taj from Mehtab Bagh

    Mehtab Bagh across the river for sunset on the Taj, then an evening free in Agra.

  4. Day 2 · 6:00 AM

    Sunrise at the Taj Mahal

    Sunrise at the Taj Mahal, when the marble turns and the complex is at its quietest.

  5. Day 2 · 10:00 AM

    Breakfast, checkout and Agra Fort

    Breakfast and checkout, then Agra Fort with your guide.

  6. Day 2 · 1:30 PM

    Lunch and the drive back to Delhi

    Lunch in Agra, then the drive back to Delhi, arriving around 5 pm.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car for both days
  • Professional chauffeur
  • Licensed local guides in Delhi and Agra
  • Hotel or airport pickup and drop in Delhi NCR
  • Monument entry tickets, if selected
  • Bottled water during sightseeing
  • All tolls, parking, fuel and driver allowances

What it does not cover

  • Hotel in Agra unless added to your package
  • Personal expenses, shopping and extra beverages
  • Tips for the guide and driver
  • Camera and video fees at monuments
  • Anything not listed under inclusions

Questions people ask

Is the hotel included?
One night can be included depending on the package you choose, and you pick the hotel category.
Which Delhi monuments can we see?
Red Fort, Jama Masjid, India Gate, Humayun's Tomb and Qutub Minar are all possible — how many depends on the time we have.
Can the tour end in Agra instead of Delhi?
Yes. It is a private tour, so the drop can be wherever your onward travel needs it.
Can we start from Delhi airport?
Yes, airport pickup works the same as hotel pickup.
